description: This file contains extension methods for executing data migration create and update methods, utilizing reflection to invoke methods dynamically based on naming conventions.

classes.name: DataMigrationExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for executing data migration create and update methods via reflection.

methods.name: ExecuteCreateMethodAsync
methods.description: Executes the create method (synchronous or asynchronous) of a data migration object.

methods.name: ExecuteUpdateMethodsAsync
methods.description: Executes all applicable update methods for a data migration object starting from a specific version.

methods.name: GetCreateMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Create' method info if it exists and returns an int.

methods.name: GetCreateAsyncMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the 'CreateAsync' method info if it exists and returns a Task<int>.

methods.name: GetUpdateMethods
methods.description: Collects all 'UpdateFrom' methods that return int or Task<int> into a dictionary keyed by version.

methods.name: GetUpdateMethod
methods.description: Parses method info to identify 'UpdateFrom' methods and extract their version number.
